entries.title: STEM for Kids: Sound
entries.description: Kids will discover how vibrations create sound and experiment with pitch and volume by making salt dance with sound waves and crafting their ownnbsp;musical instrument.\nRecommended for children 5-10 years old.\nFree.

entries.title: Who Wears This Hat? with Rochelle Rabouin
entries.description: Listen to a stories about hats and learn about the many service occupations and situations where people traditionally wear hats.nbsp;Participants will discover how these "hat wearing people" benefit our local and global community.

entries.title: 3D Design & Printing
entries.description: Learn to design in Tinkercad and see your creation come to life with our 3D printer!

entries.title: Holiday Bath Bombs
entries.description: Learn about the science behind bath bombs as you create your own!

entries.title: Family Storytime
entries.description: nbsp;After Storytime concludes, families are invited to Stay Play!

entries.title: Art Club
entries.description: Join us for an afternoon featuring a variety of fun arts and crafts activities for kids.

entries.title: Monthly STEM Workshop
entries.description: Join us for our monthly STEM Workshop presented by teen volunteers innbsp;Girls Empowered in Math and Science (GEMS)!

entries.title: Science Academy Presents: Balloon Inflators
entries.description: In Balloon Inflators, you willnbsp;explore hownbsp;everyday ingredients can generate gas to blow up a balloon.

entries.title: Sew Easy! Hand Sewing Workshop
entries.description: This program, led by volunteer Divya,nbsp;will guide children through creating their very own hand-sewn project.

entries.title: LEGO® Fun!
entries.description: Create something cool?

entries.title: Sunday Crafternoon: Painted Pumpkins
entries.description: Adults are strongly encouraged to join us and get their craft on.

entries.title: Mental Health Fair
entries.description: Learn about how to improve stress and ways to show up and support our community's teens.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 来这里轻松交流，并了解改善和缓解压力的方法。

entries.title: Diwali Celebration
entries.description: Come celebrate Diwali with a story, informative presentation,nbsp;arts, crafts, dance, and snacks!

entries.title: STEM Sundays: Chromatography Experiment
entries.description: For each STEM Sunday, we will feature a fun, hands-on activity to help learners develop their Science, Tech, Engineering, ornbsp;Math skills and experience.

entries.title: Make It Mondays: Scarecrows
entries.description: Each week will feature a different activity that focuses on building creativity, social-emotional, and school readiness skills through art.

entries.title: Rescue Readers - Reading with the San José Animal Care Center
entries.description: Rescue Readers is a one-hour program for all readers, where participants read to the animals at the SJ Animal Care Adoption Center.

entries.title: STEM Club: Soil Layers and Worm Study
entries.description: Drop in and join us every Monday from 4pm-5pm for an evening of STEM related family fun!

entries.title: Alum Rock 3D Printing Club
entries.description: nbsp;We meet once a month to use Tinkercad and our imaginations to design and print objects using our 3D printer.nbsp;Staff will be on hand to demonstrate Tinkercad and OrcaSlicer and help with designing and slicing objects.

entries.title: Ricky Roo & Friends Puppet Show
entries.description: Join the Seven Trees Library for a fun puppet show given by Ricky Roo Friends!

entries.title: Ceramic Dish Painting with Arely Cardenas and Local Color
entries.description: Bring your imagination to life with artist Arely Cardenas and Local Color's free ceramic dish painting workshop (for ages 5 and up).

entries.title: Friends of the Milpitas Library Big Winter Book Sale
entries.description: Amazon Sales We have a large catalog of books for sale on Amazon, and we try to offer the lowest price for every title that we list.

entries.title: Little Explorers: Wonderful Winter!
entries.description: We may not have snow, but we can still play in a wintery way, with a variety of snowy-themed crafts and play activities.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 即使这里没有下雪，也能通过各种冰雪主题手工和游戏体验冬季。Little Explorers 是面向幼儿和学龄前儿童家庭的每月创意活动。每月第一个星期五一起探索新的游戏与学习方式。

entries.title: Kids Keva Club for ages 5 and up
entries.description: Lego lovers will enjoy the freedom to build.

entries.title: Teen Manga Book Club
entries.description: The first 5 Registrants will receive their very own copy of the first book of the series to keep (you will be notified 1 week before we meet for book club) and you can pick up your copy at the Adult Reference desk (downstairs).

entries.title: Once Upon a Garden (family night)
entries.description: Wander through Faerie Village Meet and pose for photos with Santa and his sleigh, storybook characters, and a holiday fairy on stilts Delight in children’s crafts and holiday shopping Head to the Gnome Nom Cafe for hot chocolate and cookies Adults enjoy a complimentary glass of champagne We’ve decked the halls and strung up the lights, so come visit, shop, and enjoy the festivities!
entries.priorTitleZh: Once Upon a Garden（家庭之夜）
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 漫步 Faerie Village，与圣诞老人和雪橇、故事书角色以及踩高跷的节日仙子合影；参加儿童手工和节日购物，到 Gnome Nom Cafe 喝热巧克力、吃饼干。成人可获赠一杯香槟。花园已挂满节日灯饰，欢迎来逛、购物并享受节庆氛围！

entries.title: Family BINGO
entries.description: We will be running multiple rounds, so you can drop in and play anytime.
entries.priorTitleZh: 家庭 BINGO 宾果游戏
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 活动将进行多轮游戏，大家可随时到场参加。

entries.title: Holiday Jazz Music
entries.description: They will perform popular holiday music, including songs such as "Jingle Bells," "Frosty the Snowman," "Let It Snow," “Rockin’ Around the Christmas Tree,” and others.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: MAK Band Jazz 将带来节日歌曲合唱演出。乐队包括吉他、尤克里里、小号、次中音萨克斯、中音萨克斯、单簧管、长号、贝斯、鼓、口琴和打击乐，并有特邀爵士音乐家参与。曲目包括《Jingle Bells》《Frosty the Snowman》《Let It Snow》《Rockin’ Around the Christmas Tree》等。这是面向家庭的活动。

entries.title: Baby Sign and Sing
entries.description: Adult Caregivers will learn basic signs to communicate with their babies.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欢迎来到一楼活动室参加婴儿手语与歌唱活动。

entries.title: Domingos de Matiné con merienda
entries.description: After the movie, there will be a brief discussion about the movie’s history, its making and themes.
entries.priorTitleZh: 周日下午电影与点心（Domingos de Matiné con merienda）
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 电影结束后，将简短讨论影片的历史、制作过程和主题。观影时提供点心。

entries.title: LEGO Club for Grades K-8
entries.description: Children will use their creativity and engineering skills to free build anything they can imagine.
entries.priorTitleZh: K–8 年级 LEGO 积木俱乐部
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 孩子们将发挥创造力和工程技能，自由搭建自己想象中的各种作品。这是可随时到场参加的活动。

entries.title: Growing Readers: Help Your Aspiring Writer
entries.description: A free workshop for parents and caregivers presented by Santa Clara County Office of Education and The Reading Program of Santa Clara County Library District.
entries.priorTitleZh: 培养阅读者：帮助有写作兴趣的孩子
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 面向父母和照护者的工作坊，由 Santa Clara County Office of Education 和 Santa Clara County Library District 的 The Reading Program 联合举办，帮助孩子建立写作自信。

entries.title: Virtual Author Talk: Robin Ha
entries.description: This book uses comic‑style recipes to show simple steps, helpful tips, and tasty dishes, giving beginners and seasoned cooks a playful way to learn Korean cuisine at home.

entries.title: Poetry in the Dark
entries.description: Let’s gather to listen deeply, celebrate difference, and honor the many languages that shape our community.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 今年十二月，欢迎来到 Cupertino 图书馆，在柔和昏暗的灯光下共度诗歌分享之夜。不同年龄、文化和语言背景的参与者可分享口头和书面诗歌，每人都可以向小组朗读自己的诗作。活动由 Cupertino 桂冠诗人 Thomas Célérier 主持。欢迎所有人参加，无需经验。

entries.title: Tiny Toots Concert: Farmer Arann
entries.description: Farmer Arann will be here with his instruments, big voice, unique songs, and super fun personality!

entries.title: Adult & Teen Crafternoon: Felted Snowmen
entries.description: Come learn the basics of needle felting to create a cozy winter friend, from a simple snowman for beginner's to a more elaborate snow animal if you'd like to experiment!

entries.title: Merry Pixie Pages
entries.description: Every rhyme, song, and story helps build the skills kids need to become confident readers.

entries.title: A Look into the Night Sky with Astro Everywhere
entries.description: We’ll gather in the Treetop Room for a live astronomy show featuring planetarium software to explore the night sky as seen from Palo Alto.
entries.priorTitleZh: 与 Astro Everywhere 一起探索夜空
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 大家将在 Treetop Room 参加现场天文演示，使用天文馆软件探索从 Palo Alto 看到的夜空。

entries.title: Button Making Pop-up for Teens!
entries.description: Use old manga and comics to make a unique design or create your own from scratch.
